name: tinynet
what: A stand-in for a Cellpose model in the test pack: 64 bytes of ASCII text, not weights. It lets pack status, fetch-models and the pin check run without a real model. The bytes are stand_in_content followed by one line feed.
stand_in_content: germquant test pack: tinynet stand-in weights, not a real model
licence_note: MIT; a text stand-in. Real Cellpose-derived cards state that the Cellpose training data include CC BY-NC sets.
